commands.command: set -eu; DB="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68/tracker_database"; echo TOTALS; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COUNT(*) AS devices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples) AS samples, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_evidence_events) AS alerts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM identity_continuity_candidates) AS identity_candidates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow_me_observations) AS follow_obs FROM devices;"; echo TYPES; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT deviceType, COUNT(*) AS n FROM devices GROUP BY deviceType ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20;"; echo TRACKING; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT trackingStatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM devices GROUP BY trackingStatus ORDER BY n DESC;"; echo CALIBRATION; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT calibrationLabel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM devices GROUP BY calibrationLabel ORDER BY n DESC;"; echo RECENCY; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "WITH m AS (SELECT MAX(lastSeenAt) AS mx FROM devices) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt>=mx-60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_1m, SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt>=mx-300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_5m, SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt>=mx-900000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_15m, COUNT(*) AS total FROM devices,m;"; echo APPLE_TRACKER_ROWS; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(firstSeenAt) AS first_ms, MAX(lastSeenAt) AS last_ms FROM devices WHERE manufacturerId=76 AND (deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR sensorData LIKE '%Find%');"; echo APPLE_TRACKER_BY_TYPE; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT deviceType, COALESCE(beaconType,'') AS beacon, COUNT(*) AS n FROM devices WHERE manufacturerId=76 AND (deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR sensorData LIKE '%Find%') GROUP BY deviceType, beacon ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20;"; echo APPLE_TRACKER_RECENT; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "WITH m AS (SELECT MAX(lastSeenAt) AS mx FROM devices) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt>=mx-60000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_1m, SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt>=mx-300000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_5m, COUNT(*) AS total FROM devices,m WHERE manufacturerId=76 AND (deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR sensorData LIKE '%Find%');"; echo TACTICAL_SAMPLES; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COALESCE(deviceName,'(none)') AS name, COALESCE(vendorName,'') AS vendor, manufacturerId, COALESCE(tacticalCategory,'') AS category, COALESCE(deviceType,'') AS type, COUNT(*) AS samples, MAX(timestamp) AS last_ms FROM signal_samples WHERE isTactical=1 GROUP BY name,vendor,manufacturerId,category,type ORDER BY samples DESC LIMIT 30;"; echo HUAWEI_PUBLIC_SAFETY; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT d.lastDeviceName AS name, d.vendorName AS vendor, d.manufacturerId, d.deviceType, d.beaconType, d.trackingStatus, d.followingScore, a.evidenceSource, a.confidence, a.reasonText, a.parsedValue, COUNT(*) AS events FROM devices d LEFT JOIN alert_evidence_events a ON a.deviceFingerprint=d.fingerprint WHERE d.lastDeviceName LIKE 'HUAWEI WATCH FIT%' GROUP BY d.fingerprint,a.evidenceSource,a.confidence,a.reasonText,a.parsedValue;"; echo ALERT_TYPES; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT eventType, evidenceSource, confidence, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alert_evidence_events GROUP BY eventType,evidenceSource,confidence ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30;"
